ios.desc:
Stop taking notes. Start being present.

Convoxa doesn't just transcribe what's said. Snap the whiteboard, drop in the deck, jot a thought — while it's still recording — and it weaves all of it into one note: what was discussed, what was decided, what you said you'd do.

LIVE NOTES

Meetings aren't only spoken. Someone shares a deck, sketches something on a whiteboard, sends a PDF nobody reads out loud. Add it mid-recording and it doesn't sit at the bottom of the note as an attachment — it becomes context. A photo of a whiteboard is read and written into the note alongside what people were saying about it at the time.

THE TIMELINE UNDERNEATH

Every line is timestamped. Tap one to hear exactly how it was said, so nothing in the note has to be taken on faith.

TWO WAYS TO TRANSCRIBE

Cloud transcription handles 60+ languages and labels who said what. On-device transcription runs completely offline, using your iPhone's built-in speech recognition.

A NOTE YOU CAN ACTUALLY EDIT

The note arrives formatted: headings, paragraphs, bullets, numbered lists, checklists. Underneath that is a full rich text editor, not a read-only recap.

Rewrite a line that missed the point. Tick off action items as you finish them. Highlight, color, restructure. Your edits are yours and stay exactly where you put them.

ONE PRESS TO START

Action Button, Siri, Lock Screen, or Control Center. Start at the beginning of a meeting or halfway through — long meetings, quick calls, or a thought in the car. Recording starts before the moment passes.

CONFIDENTIAL BY DEFAULT

On-device transcription never sends your audio anywhere. It doesn't leave your iPhone, because it never needs to.

If you choose cloud transcription for accuracy or language coverage, the audio is deleted the moment it's processed. It is never stored, never shared, and never used to train anything. Neither are your notes — they aren't read, kept, or fed into any model.

AFTER THE MEETING

Every note is searchable from Spotlight without opening the app. Export as plain text, Markdown, or PDF. Everything syncs privately over iCloud, so a meeting recorded on your iPhone is on your iPad before you sit down with it.

PRICING

Free to try, with recording hours included in every mode — cloud transcription included, nothing held back to a preview. Convoxa Pro is a monthly subscription that unlocks unlimited on-device transcription and 20 hours of cloud transcription each month.

show_hn.title: Show HN: A 4.8MB native iOS voice notes app built with SwiftUI

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I wanted to share a project I’ve been working on called Convoxa. It’s a native iOS transcriber/summarizer. I had two main goals: keep it efficient and keep it private.

THE TECH STACK

100% Swift & SwiftUI: No heavy cross-platform wrappers or bloated dependencies.

Binary Size: The final build is only 4.8 MB.

Transcription: Uses Apple's latest speech APIs for maximum privacy and efficiency.

THE CHALLENGE: BYPASSING THE 4K CONTEXT LIMIT

The biggest technical hurdle was working with Apple’s foundation models. The default context window is capped at 4096 tokens, which is practically useless for anything over a 10-minute meeting transcript.

I ended up building a recursive chunking method to "feed" the model long-form data without losing the global context of the conversation. I use a sliding window approach where each chunk's summary informs the next, ensuring the final output doesn't "hallucinate" at the seams where the chunks meet. It’s now stable enough for long-form audio while remaining entirely on-device for supported hardware.

PRIVACY & AI MODES

On-Device: (Apple Intelligence required) - Total local processing.

Cloud: With reasoning for intelligent insights (Zero Data Retention).

I’m currently in the pre-order phase (out on Feb 3rd) and would love to get some feedback from this community on the performance and the chunking logic.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/convoxa-ai-meeting-minutes/id6755150446
